label: Derived from a harness-authored synthetic session corpus (P4, R91). Its resemblance to real usage is unproven and was not tested: no real traffic exists to compare against (D3), and the corpus was declared unvalidated by choice rather than validated by a check. Its composition is a pre-registered design parameter -- 40 sessions across five families, 50% literal-bearing -- chosen for measurability, not realism, and its cache repeat rate is a dial, not an observation. Per-family figures are reported separately so any reweighting is arithmetic rather than a regeneration. RE-FROZEN 2026-09-03 (D-19(d)): the `anaphora` family adds 20 three-turn sessions whose last turn is a contentless probe and the only scored turn, because 35 of the previous 95 scored turns were turn 1 and could not respond to a retrieval-side conversation knob at all. Predecessor stamp 4155c97b0a2b. Numbers measured on 4155c97b0a2b are not comparable across this re-freeze and must not be spliced with numbers measured after it. RE-FROZEN AGAIN 2026-09-03 (D-20): the anaphora family's turn 2 was rebuilt to carry a distinctive fragment after the first run measured a suppressed effect under a mis-sized query cap, and the n=1 arm was dropped. Predecessor stamp 49b525f2a131.

pre_registration.validation: none by choice (CP-4a option iv) -- see R91

anaphora.design: 3 turns; turns 1-2 build-up, turn 3 a contentless probe and the ONLY scored turn
anaphora.seeded_from: 12 passage_paste + 8 locate; turn 1 and targets reused verbatim, turns 2-3 authored
anaphora.turn2_rule: names the book AND carries a <= 80-char distinctive fragment drawn from the seed's own turn 1 (D-20). The previous rule -- paraphrase, no literal quote -- existed to keep n=1 and n=2 separable and was dropped with the n=1 arm.
anaphora.scoring: metric (c) recall@k over session targets, LAST TURN ONLY, computed from the run artifact's per-turn records
anaphora.decision_rule: plans/mitya-v2/04-plan/phase-7-corpus-anaphora-family.md section 4 -- pre-registered magnitudes, NOT an MDE
anaphora.validation: none by choice, inherited -- R91/O5 stands and this family compounds the O5/O10 label rather than fixing it
anaphora.arms: n_prev_queries 0 and 2 only (owner, D-20); n=1 dropped
